description: What the user has collected in Sightglass. Returns up to 100 boards with nextBoardCursor for more; pass boardCursor to continue. With no `kind` it adds a count summary; with `kind` it lists saved ads, landing pages (site_pages), companies or followed brands. Pass nextCursor as cursor for the next page of items. Each row has one picture; the matching get_ tool returns every creative, screenshot, logo and the page HTML. Fields this workspace can't see are null and named in the item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits, traffic). A capped list sets `planLimit` (`maxResults`, `hiddenResults`) and has no next page. Never estimate omitted values. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

boardCursor.description: Pass nextBoardCursor from a prior result to list more boards.

boardId.description: Limit to one board; ids come from `boards` in this result.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of this same call, to get the next page. Keep every other argument the same.

kind.description: Which saved items to list. Omit for just the boards and a count summary.

limit.description: Results per page: 20 by default, up to 40. Use the user's number when they give one; for more than 40, page with cursor.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_list_saved
title: List saved items
